steps.caption: Open Buildings → Supply → Match and choose the Lumen Harbour Tech requirement.
Each option on the stored shortlist has a feedback form and shows its status — proposed here.
Client feedback on Harbour Point floor 4: liked the floor plate.
Now a rejection on Harbour Point floor 5. A reason is required.
Shortlist history at the bottom: each shortlist version with how many options were eligible, and every piece of feedback with its reason.
Rejections are remembered: the company's memory shows rejected buildings and why, so they are not offered again by mistake.
